title: What is Healthings — Swiss picture
audience: brand / clinic / investor — locked 06 VO; pictures matched to each line
note: EN identical to 06. End card holds through Forever Young violin swell (~53–60s bed), then slow fade.

segments.en: You log your meals. You wear a watch. You get blood tests.
But none of it talks to each other.
Healthings connects all of it into one loop.
A licensed nutritionist reads your labs and sets your plan.
That plan becomes rules that live inside your app.
Your scale, your watch, and your CGM keep the numbers honest.
Every meal you log is checked against your plan, in seconds.
And your clinic sees the real week,
not a story from memory, and adjusts.
Clinic directs. App executes. Devices measure.
